subject: Reception and display joinery
hook: From empty foyer to front desk: the five stages.
ig:
From empty foyer to front desk: here are the five stages a reception and display scheme typically goes through.

Site visit: the space, the power and data points, and the route in.
Design: counter heights, an accessible section, display and staff storage drawn as one scheme.
Itemised quote: each element listed, so nothing is hidden in a single lump sum.
Workshop: cut, edged and built in sections in Hanley.
Installation: delivered, joined, levelled and finished by our own team.

We'd always rather talk about install timing with you at the start, so the fitting is planned around how your business runs.

The images here show the principle. Our showcase has real SUPERIO work if you want to see finished furniture. Save this for your refit and tap the link in bio to have a look.
fb:
If you've never had commercial furniture made before, it helps to know what happens when.

Here's how a reception and display scheme typically comes together with us: a site visit to measure the space and the way in, a design that puts the counter, display and staff storage together, an itemised quote, manufacture in sections in our Hanley workshop, and installation by our own team.

Install timing is something we agree with you at the start so it works around your opening hours.

These are concept images to show the stages; you'll find genuine finished work on our showcase.
